query: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure OCI remaining performance obligations RPO AI contracts FY2027
normalized: ai cloud contracts fy2027 infrastructure obligations oci oracle performance remaining rpo

output.content:
**Oracle’s FY2027 AI-cloud/RPO position:** At the end of fiscal Q1 2027 (August 31, 2026), Oracle reported **$664 billion of remaining performance obligations (RPO)**, up **$209 billion year over year**. [[1]] 

Oracle said it booked **more than $30 billion of additional AI-cloud contracts** during the quarter, as demand for AI training and inference services continued to exceed available supply. [[1]] 

OCI/IaaS revenue was **$7.4 billion in Q1 FY2027**, up **121% year over year**; combined cloud revenue (IaaS plus SaaS) was **$11.6 billion**, up **62%**. [[1]] 

For conversion timing, Oracle’s Q1 FY2027 filing indicates approximately **13%** of RPO—about **$86 billion**—is expected to be recognized in the next 12 months, while approximately **50%** is expected within 36 months. [[2]] 

The important analytical caveat is that RPO is contracted, unrecognized revenue rather than OCI revenue guidance, and Oracle does not disclose the portion of the $664 billion backlog attributable specifically to OCI or to individual AI customers. [[2]] 

For full FY2027, Oracle guided to at least **$90 billion of total revenue** and **$8.10 of non-GAAP EPS**; it did not provide a standalone full-year OCI revenue target in the cited earnings release. [[1]] 

Oracle also stated that the structure of the new AI contracts creates **no incremental impact on its capital-raising plans**, suggesting a material role for prepayment, customer-supplied hardware, or other capital-light contract structures rather than Oracle solely funding all incremental compute capacity. [[1]]

Oracle Q1: Half of $664B RPO Expected as Revenue in 3 Years
